text: Temporary queue_dir promotion avoids mutating the permanent promotion_queue or semantic_staging directories. The 09A and 09B fronts used this approach by writing individual candidate JSON files into a front-local temporary directory such as tmp_agent/front_ingestion_small_batch_09b/promotion_queue_09b. The promote_candidate function accepts a queue_dir parameter that overrides the default promotion_queue path. After promotion completes, the temporary directory remains as an artifact but does not affect the canonical pipeline state. This boundary is important because the permanent promotion_queue may contain unrelated candidates from other fronts or processes. Mutating it could introduce unintended side effects or conflicts. The temporary directory also serves as an exact record of what was promoted in this front, which is useful for audit and rollback verification.
summary: Use temporary queue_dir to avoid mutating permanent promotion_queue
